title: Module 7 — Professional context, culture and systematization
description: Read job ads and go through a job interview, get to know the Portuguese-speaking world and its sayings, and consolidate the present and simple-past verb systems from every earlier module.

topics.title: Job ads, CV and interview
topics.brief: Reading job ads and a short CV; a job interview (Fale-me um pouco sobre si, Quais são as suas qualidades?); formal versus informal register at work.

topics.title: The Portuguese-speaking world
topics.brief: Geography and culture of the CPLP countries (Portugal, Brasil, Angola, Cabo Verde, Moçambique…); basic facts and a few culture-specific vocabulary differences between European and Brazilian Portuguese.

topics.title: Proverbs and sayings
topics.brief: Common Portuguese proverbs and sayings (Quem não arrisca, não petisca; Mais vale tarde do que nunca) with their English equivalents and everyday usage.

topics.title: Present and past tense systematization
topics.brief: Review and contrast of regular and irregular verb conjugations across Presente do Indicativo and Pretérito Perfeito Simples, drawing on every verb group introduced in Modules 1–6.

topics.title: Near-synonyms and the -ção suffix
topics.brief: Distinguishing close verb pairs (conhecer vs saber, olhar vs ver, escutar vs ouvir); the word-forming suffix -ção (informação, conversação, educação) and how it turns verbs into nouns.
